# Generated by gen_p06.py - do not edit by hand.
source React 19.3.1 on jsdom 30.1.3 (tools/oracle), cross-checked line by line against a positional model in tools/gen_p06.py
seed 1
compare records dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value title=value log=text
explain node:props=R2 log:text=R6
requirement R1 same type at the same position: the DOM node is kept (same label), its props and text are brought up to date
requirement R2 a prop that is gone from the new element is cleared on the kept node
requirement R3 a different type at a position gets a new node, and it stays at that position among its siblings
requirement R4 new children beyond the old ones are added after them
requirement R5 old children beyond the new ones are removed, once each, however many are adjacent, and also after earlier renders
requirement R6 handlers follow the latest render: a click runs the new handler once, and nothing for a removed one
requirement R7 changes at several depths in one render: kept, replaced, added and removed nodes together
requirement R8 random pairs and triples of trees: the container ends up as the last tree, and the nodes that stay are the ones the positional rule keeps
requirement E2E whole sessions of renders, clicks and dumps
